concerns.text: T040b-gen (Generate Verified Synthetic Base) is listed as a parallel task [P] alongside T040 (Fetch Real Data). However, T040b-gen is explicitly defined as a fallback triggered ONLY if T040 fails. Parallel execution is impossible because T040b-gen's execution condition depends on the runtime outcome of T040. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' and 'Parallel-safe' rules. T040b-gen must be sequenced after T040 with a conditional dependency, not marked [P].

T040c (Adapt Synthetic Parameters) is marked [P] and listed as parallel to T040b-gen. However, T040c's logic ('Parse the fetched Cochrane data...') explicitly depends on the successful completion of T040. If T040 fails, T040c cannot run. If T040 succeeds, T040c runs. It cannot run in parallel with T040. This is a hidden ordering violation.

T008-code (Write Unit Test Code) and T009 (Unit test test_generator.py) are marked [P] and listed as parallel to T010 (Implement generator.py). The task descriptions explicitly state 'DEPENDS ON: T010 (stub or full implementation)'. While tests can be written before code (TDD), the task T008-code describes 'verifying that generated variance matches...', which implies the existence of the generator logic to test. More critically, T008-run and T009 require the *execution* of the test against the generator. If T010 is not complete, these tests cannot pass or generate the required artifacts (test_variance_check.json). Marking them [P] suggests they can run independently of T010's completion, which is false for the execution phase. T008-code might be parallel, but T008-run and T009 must follow T010.

T034d (Execute Sensitivity Sweep) is marked [P] and listed as parallel to T034a (Sensitivity Sweep CLI). T034d's description says 'Run code/simulation/generator.py with levels...'. This execution depends on the CLI arguments being added in T034a. T034d cannot run before T034a is complete. This is a direct producer-consumer violation.

T028 (Generate Report) depends on T034d (Sensitivity Sweep), T021 (Estimation Results), and T018 (REML Failures). T028 is listed in Phase 5, but T034d is also in Phase 5. The dependency graph implies T034d must complete before T028. However, T034d is marked [P] (parallel-safe) alongside other Phase 5 tasks. If T034d is truly parallel, it implies it has no dependencies, but it depends on T010 (Generator) and T034a (CLI). The [P] tag is misleading here as it hides the sequential dependency on T034a and T010.

T040b-doc (Verify Synthetic Base Documentation) is marked [P] and listed as parallel to T040b-gen. However, T040b-doc's logic ('Verify... grep -q synthetic_base_params') depends on T040b-gen having written the parameters to config.yaml. T040b-doc cannot run before T040b-gen completes. This is a hidden ordering violation.
